coreIdea: Synthesized = child→parent (bottom-up). Inherited = parent/left-sibling→current (top-down/left-to-right). S-attributed ⊊ L-attributed. Bottom-up parsing evaluates inherited attrs ONLY if L-attributed.
mustRememberFormulas: S-attributed ⊊ L-attributed (S-attributed is always also L-attributed)
Bottom-up (LR) parsing can evaluate inherited attributes IFF SDD is L-attributed
S-attributed SDDs always evaluable bottom-up at reduce time
